title: Local-surjectivity part of compatible finite-etale Hom descent
statement: For a finite etale morphism p and a module morphism f, if the pullback of f to every finite-etale splitting chart agrees with an epic local map d, then the underlying sheaf morphism of f is locally surjective.

proof.text: Construct splitting charts through all points from finite_etale_etale_local_split. Their maps are an etale cover, hence a pro-etale covering family; the construction admits degree zero and an empty indexing family over the empty base.

The underlying module inverse image is ordinary abelian inverse image via profinitePointModuleForgetPullbackIso. The source upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction and isIso_of_isIso_localizationRestriction therefore show that chart pullbacks jointly reflect isomorphisms of internal modules.

Let C be the cokernel of f. Every chart inverse image preserves this cokernel and identifies the pullback of f with the given epic map, so every inverse image of C is zero. Apply joint reflection of isomorphisms to the zero map C to the zero object to conclude C is zero. Hence f is epic. Mod.forget preserves epimorphisms, and Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi converts the underlying epimorphism into the required local surjectivity.

proof_origin.place: Local computation; splitting-chart cover, literal sheaf restriction and module action descent

from.place: Epi cancellation via local surjectivity of the underlying sheaf map

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleSplitHom_local_surjective
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite p] [Etale p]
    (Q P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (f : Q ⟶ P)
    (d : ∀ c : FiniteEtaleModuleChart p,
      (upperStar Λ c.map).obj Q ⟶ (upperStar Λ c.map).obj P)
    (hf : ∀ c, (upperStar Λ c.map).map f = d c)
    (hd : ∀ c, Epi (d c)) : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f.hom
